name: spec_driven_develop
description: Spec-driven development workflow for AI coding agents: architecture-first planning, task decomposition, GitHub Issue/PR tracking, Deep Discuss, and adaptive control for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other Markdown-capable agents.

categoryDescription: 开发、调试、评审、测试、架构与工程交付
